description: SIDEWALKS is a dataset listed in Hawaii Department of Transportation open data portal (highways.hidot.hawaii.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Hawaii Department of Transportation. This dataset is an inventory of sidewalks along Hawaii Highways. Information such as sidewalk location, material type, route and whether or not it falls on the NHS. Coverage: Hawaii. The portal files it under the category Roadway Data. Its tags are tunnel, pfes. The table has 31 columns. The portal shows 2024-07-25 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-highways-hidot-hawaii-gov-portal.
